benchmark_entries.official_metric: Official subtask metric; generally multi-label F1 for persuasion

benchmark_entries.title: MAFALDA: annotated fallacy classification
benchmark_entries.task: Fallacy identification with subjective multi-answer labeling
benchmark_entries.official_metric: Official ambiguity-aware evaluation; preserve multi-answer acceptance
benchmark_entries.license: Verify repository and dataset licensing before commercial use
benchmark_entries.acquisition: Retrieve under approved terms; do not coerce ambiguous labels into one exclusive answer.

benchmark_entries.title: FOLIO: first-order logic natural-language inference
benchmark_entries.task: Entailment, contradiction, unknown under supplied premises
benchmark_entries.acquisition: Use released train/validation data for development; avoid unpublished test leakage.

benchmark_entries.title: AVeriTeC: real-world web-based fact verification
benchmark_entries.task: Claim verdict PLUS retrieved justifying evidence
benchmark_entries.official_metric: Official AVeriTeC composite score from eval.py
benchmark_entries.acquisition: Do not embed dataset in commercial app without permission. Benchmark offline under allowed use; run official eval.py.

benchmark_entries.title: SciFact: scientific claim verification
benchmark_entries.license: Claims CC BY 4.0; abstracts ODC-By 1.0; code Apache-2.0
benchmark_entries.acquisition: Acquire official releases, attribute records correctly and apply the three separate licensing terms.

benchmark_entries.title: CLadder: causal reasoning
benchmark_entries.license: MIT code; dataset rights to review
benchmark_entries.acquisition: Use published balanced dataset and original answer mapping; stratify query type and rung.

benchmark_entries.title: Corr2Cause: causation vs correlation
benchmark_entries.task: Identify unsupported causal claims from correlation patterns
benchmark_entries.official_metric: Original classification accuracy by causal relation
benchmark_entries.acquisition: Acquire officially released data; separate training from locked tests.

benchmark_entries.title: FActScore: factual precision of long-form generation
benchmark_entries.task: Atomic fact decomposition with source support
benchmark_entries.official_metric: Supported atomic facts / all extracted atomic facts; monitor response ratio
benchmark_entries.acquisition: Run as supporting diagnostic; not a substitute for claim-evidence human-reviewed judgments.
